subject: Acme Robotics onramp: success criteria, GPU reserve & burst runbook
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara@acmerobotics.com>, Tim Garcia <tim.garcia@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T15:08:00-08:00
Subject: Acme onramp recap & proposed capacity plan

Hi Sara / Tim — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap from our discovery + proposed next steps so we have alignment before the kickoff: 

Summary of needs:
- Primary goal: integrate Redwood inference into Acme's internal assistant (search + action generation) and validate latency/cost at 10k daily active queries.
- Success criteria (customer-facing): P95 generation latency <= 300ms for 512-token requests, semantic similarity for retrieval >= 0.78 on your eval set, and end-to-end cost per 1k queries under your target (TBD).
- Timeline: 4-week trial window (ideal kickoff week of Dec 5) with a 2-week internal prep period.

Capacity/ops proposal (high level):
- Baseline reserved capacity: 4x A100-equivalent GPUs (reserved for trial baseline).
- Burst headroom: allow autoscale burst to 8x GPUs for sustained spikes (burst policy described below).
- Autoscaling policy: maintain target GPU utilization 60–80%; if sustained >85% for 90s, spin up 1 GPU; scale down after 10m of <50% utilization. Warm nodes: 10-minute warm window for model load.
- Caching: enable prefix/KV cache for interactive flows; expect ~30% token-cost reduction on repeat patterns.

Attachments: onramp-acme-capacity-v1.pdf (capacity diagrams) and msa-sample.docx (standard MSA sample).

Immediate asks for Acme:
1) Confirm trial kickoff week (Dec 5 preferred).
2) Confirm baseline throughput target (10k DAU / average concurrency estimate) or share a narrower QPS estimate.
3) Provide network & VPC egress requirements (IP allowlist, private peering preference).
4) Any mandated compliance evidence (SOC2 report or specific questionnaire).

Next steps we suggest:
- You confirm items 1–3 this week, we finalize the reserved SKU mapping & produce a one-page statement of work.
- DocuSign link for PO will be sent once scope is locked.
- Redwood will provision reserved capacity 72 hours before kickoff and run a canary workload with your sample payload set.

Thanks — I can schedule a 30-minute follow up demo if you want the infra team to walk through the burst behavior.

Best,
Naomi Feldman

Subject: Re: Acme onramp recap & proposed capacity plan

Thanks Naomi — this is helpful and aligns with our internal readout. A few clarifying questions before we lock dates: 

- Cost sensitivity: can you provide a ballpark cost range for the reserved 4x baseline + burst to 8x for a 4-week trial (so we can budget for the PO)?
- Data residency & compliance: we require SOC2 evidence and prefer data to remain in US regions for the trial. Is the private VPC option available for this trial?
- Acceptance gates: we will own the similarity metric evaluation (we'll send the eval set). Are there standard SLO examples you recommend for automated pass/fail?

Also — please send the canary runbook and any recommended sample payload templates. I'm attaching Acme's trial requirements doc for reference: acme-trial-reqs.pdf

If everything looks reasonable we'll aim to sign the PO next week.

-Sara
Sara Lin
Head of Integrations | Acme Robotics
sara@acmerobotics.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <sara@acmerobotics.com>, Tim Garcia <tim.garcia@acmerobotics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Acme onramp recap & proposed capacity plan

Sara — thanks, answers inline below and attached more detail. 

1) Ballpark cost (trial, USD): baseline 4x reserved GPUs + moderate traffic = estimated $24k–$36k for the 4-week window depending on token volumes and caching efficacy. Burst headroom incurs on-demand rates only for minutes of usage; expect an additional $3k–$8k if bursts are frequent. We'll provide a more precise estimate once you share sample payload stats.

2) Data residency & compliance: yes, SOC2 report available — will share under NDA. Private VPC option is available for trial customers; for the Dec 5 kickoff we can provision a scoped VPC peering (networking lead will need IP ranges).

3) Acceptance gates / SLO examples: recommended automated checks we run during the trial:
- P95 latency <= 300ms for 512 tokens (pass if 90% of sampling windows meet it).
- End-to-end semantic similarity >= 0.78 on your eval set (we run 3 nightly runs and take median).
- No critical errors (500s) above 0.1% of requests.

I've attached: acme-gpu-burst-plan.xlsx (detailed scaling timelines & SKU mapping) and eval-criteria-checklist.csv (format for your eval set + pass/fail columns). Also sending DocuSign link for the PO when you're ready.

Proposed immediate plan: you share the eval set + approximate QPS by EOD Wednesday; we finalize PO and provision reserved capacity week of Nov 30 so we're ready for Dec 5. Confirmable?

Cheers,
Naomi

Attachments: acme-gpu-burst-plan.xlsx, eval-criteria-checklist.csv
